method: primary self-account plus state gaol records plus licence record plus independent prison-history synthesis

important_deltas.finding: The v2 cinematic detail that Bunyan had a Bible in his hands at the arrest is not retained without a primary locator.
The 1672 gaol calendar HSA1672/W/20 remains state administrative evidence in the historical argument rather than a decorative anecdote.
The document visual is now the separately identified public Bedford Archives HSA1667/W/58 gaol list. It is explicitly dated 1667 and is not presented as the inaccessible 1672 Slide65 reproduction.
The 9 May 1672 preaching licence is separated from the broad release narrative and bound as its own documented event.
Pilgrim's Progress composition is not reduced to twelve continuous years in one unchanged cell.

unsupported_popular_claims.claim: Bunyan was arrested with a Bible visibly in his hands.
Bunyan spent exactly twelve uninterrupted years in one cell writing Pilgrim's Progress.
The public HSA1667/W/58 image is a reproduction of HSA1672/W/20.

claim_upgrade_conditions.upgrade_requires: contemporary or Bunyan-authored locator explicitly describing the object at the moment of arrest

visual_plan.concept: 1667 Bedford gaol calendar HSA1667/W/58 listing John Bunyan
